title: Inclusion of the ideal-power torsion subcomplex
statement: Let R be a commutative ring, J an ideal, and K an N-indexed cochain complex of R-modules. The degreewise inclusions Gamma_J(K^n) into K^n define a monomorphism Gamma_J(K) into K, where Gamma_J is [def-sbc-ideal-power-torsion-functor].

source.place: Tags 0BJA and 0A6T; the torsion subcomplex inclusion

proof.text: Use the actual submodule subtype inclusions as the components. The definition of primaryComponent.map makes the cochain compatibility square commute on every element. Each component is injective, hence monic; HomologicalComplex.mono_of_mono_f proves monicity of the complex map.
